open.issue: Bing Webmaster Tools not set up; IndexNow not enabled
Two display faces hotlinked from a Webflow CDN
open.detail: cdn.prod.website-files.com is an asset host nobody here controls; if it moves, the typography falls back site-wide. next/font would self-host and hash them — but it changes which bytes arrive and how fallback metrics are computed, which is a typography change wearing a performance change's clothes. Deliberate decision required.

declined.why: Zero volume, and it is the AI-spam pattern the brief itself forbids. The terms are used as vocabulary in titles, descriptions and prose where they are true.
One site, one language, identical content. hreflang between identical URLs creates a duplicate-content signal rather than resolving one.
They render no visible trail. Marking up a breadcrumb a reader cannot see is exactly what the structured-data guidelines prohibit.
No genuine FAQ or how-to content exists on the site.
No real, visible reviews. Fabricating them is a manual-action risk.

Nothing tracks when a story was last edited. Emitting the build date as dateModified would tell every crawler all twelve articles are revised on every deploy, which is false and is the same class of mistake the sitemap lastmod fix just corrected.

Not something any technical work can promise. Rank is decided by a third party against competitors nobody here controls. What is controllable is done and verified; the rest is deployment, Search Console, and earned links.
